desk.headline: Half-year profit up 30% to ¥896.5bn; full-year forecast raised to ¥1.6tn, new ¥200bn buyback and ¥200 dividend

other.label: Profit attributable to owners of parent

results: Profit attributable to shareholders rose 30% to ¥896.5bn in the six months to September, from ¥689.9bn.
Gross profits grew 27% to ¥2.07tn and net business profits 55% to ¥1.06tn; EPS rose to ¥368.81 from ¥276.20.
Interim dividend raised to ¥100 per share from ¥72.50 a year earlier.
Share buybacks in the half totalled ¥204.8bn, against ¥103.8bn a year earlier.
New buyback of up to ¥200bn (up to 35m shares, 1.4% of shares) from 16 Nov 2026 to 28 Feb 2027; the shares will be cancelled on 23 Mar 2027.

guidance.summary: Mizuho raised its full-year profit estimate by ¥200bn to ¥1.6tn (forecast EPS ¥660.42), citing first-half results, and now expects a ¥200 dividend for the year versus ¥145 last year.

items.metric: Profit attributable to owners of parent

points: CEO Masahiro Kihara called tighter US rules on data centre construction a "tail risk" after the midterm elections.
He said such rules could slow projects and raise development costs.
Press reports said the new buyback doubles Mizuho's buybacks for the year to ¥400bn; the company points to a total payout of 50% or more.
call.source: The Edge Malaysia, 13 Nov 2026; buyback notice (6-K)

watch: Pace of the ¥200bn buyback through February 2027.
Whether the ¥1.6tn profit estimate holds as the data centre and US policy risks play out.
CET1 ratio, down to 12.74% from 13.16% in six months.
